title.zh: 卷七 補帝紀第七 武成帝
title.raw: 卷七 補帝紀第七 武成帝 Volume 7 Annals 7: Emperor Wucheng

sentences.zh: 世祖武成皇帝，諱湛，神武皇帝第九子，孝昭皇帝之母弟也。

translations.literal: Emperor Wucheng, posthumous title Shizu, taboo name Zhan, was the ninth son of Emperor Shenwu and the younger brother of Emperor Xiaozhao by the same mother.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wucheng (Gao Zhan), posthumous title Shizu, was the ninth son of Emperor Shenwu and the full younger brother of Emperor Xiaozhao.

sentences.zh: 儀錶瑰傑，神武尤所鍾愛。

translations.literal: His bearing and appearance were magnificent and outstanding; Shenwu especially cherished him.
translations.idiomatic: Handsome in bearing and striking in appearance, he was especially beloved by Emperor Shenwu.

sentences.zh: 神武方招懷荒遠，乃為帝聘蠕蠕太子庵羅辰女，號「鄰和公主」。

translations.literal: When Shenwu was seeking to win over distant frontier peoples, he arranged a marriage for the Emperor with the daughter of Anluoshen, heir of the Rouran crown prince, titled "Princess Linhe."
translations.idiomatic: While Emperor Shenwu was working to bring distant peoples into allegiance, he betrothed the prince to the daughter of Anluoshen, heir of the Rouran crown prince, who was given the title Princess Linhe.

sentences.zh: 帝時年八歲，冠服端嚴，神情閑遠，華戎歎異。

translations.literal: At the time the Emperor was eight years old; his cap and robes were dignified, his expression serene and distant, and both Chinese and barbarians marveled.
translations.idiomatic: The prince was then eight years old. His dress was dignified and his manner calm and composed, and both Chinese and foreigners alike expressed admiration.

sentences.zh: 元象中，封長廣郡公。

translations.literal: During the Yuanxiang era, he was enfeoffed as Duke of Changgang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanxiang era, he was made Duke of Changgang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 天保初，進爵為王，拜尚書令，尋兼司徒，遷太尉。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao, his rank was advanced to prince; he was appointed Chief Minister of the Secretariat, soon also served concurrently as Minister over the Masses, and was transferred to Grand Commander.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Tianbao era, he was raised to princely rank, made Chief Minister of the Secretariat, soon also given concurrent appointment as Minister over the Masses, and then transferred to Grand Commander.

sentences.zh: 乾明初，楊愔等密相疏忌，以帝為大司馬，領幷州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianming, Yang Yin and others secretly kept their distance and were wary of him, and appointed the Emperor Grand Marshal with concurrent duty as Inspector of Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Qianming era, Yang Yin and his faction secretly kept their distance and were wary of him, but nevertheless made him Grand Marshal and Inspector of Bing Province.

sentences.zh: 帝旣與孝昭謀誅諸執政，遷太傅、錄尚書事、領京畿大都督。

translations.literal: Once the Emperor had joined with Xiaozhao in plotting to execute the ruling ministers, he was transferred to Grand Tutor, Recorder of the Affairs of the Secretariat, and Metropolitan Commander of the Capital Region.
translations.idiomatic: After he and Emperor Xiaozhao plotted to execute the ruling ministers, he was made Grand Tutor, Recorder of the Affairs of the Secretariat, and Metropolitan Commander of the Capital Region.

sentences.zh: 皇建初，進位右丞相。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Huangjian, he was promoted to Right Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Huangjian era, he was promoted to Right Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 孝昭幸晉陽，帝以懿親居守鄴，政事咸見委託。

translations.literal: When Xiaozhao went to Jinyang, the Emperor, as a close kinsman, remained to guard Ye, and all government affairs were entrusted to him.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozhao went to Jinyang, the prince remained at Ye as a trusted kinsman, and all government affairs were entrusted to him.

sentences.zh: 二年，孝昭崩，遺詔徵帝入統大位。

translations.literal: In the second year, Xiaozhao died; his testamentary edict summoned the Emperor to enter and succeed to the great throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Emperor Xiaozhao died. His testamentary edict summoned the prince to succeed to the throne.

sentences.zh: 及晉陽宮，發喪於崇德殿。

translations.literal: Upon reaching Jinyang Palace, the mourning was begun at Chungde Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Upon reaching Jinyang Palace, mourning rites were begun at Chungde Hall.

sentences.zh: 皇太后令所司宣遺詔，左丞相斛律金率百僚敦勸，三奏，乃許之。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager ordered the responsible offices to proclaim the testamentary edict; Left Chancellor Hulu Jin led the hundred officials in earnest urging; after three presentations, he consented.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager ordered the responsible offices to proclaim the testamentary edict. Left Chancellor Hulu Jin led the hundred officials in earnest urging, and after three presentations the prince consented.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未，乙太宰、平陽王淹為青州刺史、太傅、領司徒，以領軍大將軍、宗師、平秦王歸彥為太宰、冀州刺史。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day of the second month, Grand Preceptor and Prince of Pingyang Yan was appointed Inspector of Qing Province, Grand Tutor, and concurrent Minister over the Masses; Commander-in-Chief, Imperial Preceptor, and Prince of Pingqin Gao Guiyan was made Grand Preceptor and Inspector of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the second month, Grand Preceptor and Prince Yan of Pingyang was appointed Inspector of Qing Province, Grand Tutor, and concurrent Minister over the Masses; Commander-in-Chief, Imperial Preceptor, and Prince Gao Guiyan of Pingqin was made Grand Preceptor and Inspector of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以兼尚書令、任城王湝為司徒。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, Concurrent Chief Minister of the Secretariat and Prince of Rencheng Jun was appointed Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Concurrent Chief Minister of the Secretariat and Prince Jun of Rencheng was appointed Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 詔散騎常侍崔瞻聘于陳。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched Regular Attendant Cui Zhan on a mission of friendly inquiry to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: An edict dispatched Cui Zhan, Regular Attendant, on a diplomatic mission to Chen.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，皇太后婁氏崩。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinchou day, Empress Dowager Lou died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinchou day, Empress Dowager Lou died.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，青州刺史上言，今月庚寅河、濟清。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, the Inspector of Qing Province memorialized that on the gengyin day of this month the Yellow and Ji Rivers had cleared.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, the Inspector of Qing Province reported that on the gengyin day of that month the Yellow and Ji Rivers had run clear.

sentences.zh: 以河、濟清，改大寧二年為河清，降罪人各有差。

translations.literal: Because the Yellow and Ji Rivers had cleared, the second year of Daning was renamed Heqing, and criminals' sentences were reduced, each according to his case.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Yellow and Ji Rivers had cleared, the second year of Daning was renamed Heqing, and sentences of criminals were reduced, each according to the circumstances of his case.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，祔葬武明皇后於義平陵。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the jiashen day, Empress Wuming was jointly entombed at Yiping Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiashen day, Empress Wuming was jointly entombed at Yiping Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以尚書右僕射斛律光為尚書令。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, Right Deputy Director of the Secretariat Hulu Guang was appointed Chief Minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Hulu Guang was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，太宰、冀州刺史、平秦王歸彥據州反，詔大司馬段韶、司空婁叡討擒之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Grand Preceptor, Inspector of Ji Province, and Prince of Pingqin Gao Guiyan seized the province in rebellion; an edict ordered Grand Marshal Duan Shao and Minister of Works Lou Rui to suppress and capture him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, Grand Preceptor, Inspector of Ji Province, and Prince Gao Guiyan of Pingqin seized the province in rebellion. An edict ordered Grand Marshal Duan Shao and Minister of Works Lou Rui to suppress and capture him.

sentences.zh: 乙未，斬歸彥並其三子及黨與二十人於都市。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day, Gao Guiyan along with his three sons and twenty followers were beheaded in the capital marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, Gao Guiyan, his three sons, and twenty followers were beheaded in the capital marketplace.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以大司馬段韶為太傅，以司空婁叡為司徒，乙太傅、平陽王淹為太宰，以尚書令斛律光為司空，以太子太傅、趙郡王叡為尚書令，中書監、河間王孝琬為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, Grand Marshal Duan Shao was appointed Grand Tutor; Minister of Works Lou Rui was made Minister over the Masses; Grand Tutor and Prince of Pingyang Yan was appointed Grand Preceptor; Chief Minister of the Secretariat Hulu Guang was made Minister of Works; Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince and Prince of Zhao Commandery Rui was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat; and Director of the Secretariat and Prince of Hejian Xiaowan was made Left Deputy Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Grand Marshal Duan Shao was made Grand Tutor; Minister of Works Lou Rui was made Minister over the Masses; Grand Tutor and Prince Yan of Pingyang was appointed Grand Preceptor; Chief Minister of the Secretariat Hulu Guang was made Minister of Works; Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince and Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat; and Director of the Secretariat and Prince Xiaowan of Hejian was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，行幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the guihai day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 陳人來聘。

translations.literal: Envoys from Chen came on a mission of friendly inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys from Chen came on a diplomatic visit.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丁丑，詔兼散騎常侍封孝琰使於陳。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on the dingchou day, an edict dispatched Concurrent Regular Attendant Feng Xiaoyan as envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the dingchou day, an edict dispatched Concurrent Regular Attendant Feng Xiaoyan as envoy to Chen.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，車駕至自晉陽。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the bingchen day, the imperial carriage arrived from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the bingchen day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 是歲，殺太原王紹德。

translations.literal: That year, the Prince of Taiyuan Shaode was killed.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Prince Shaode of Taiyuan was killed.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙亥，帝詔臨朝堂策試秀才。

translations.literal: In the second year, in the first month of spring, on the yihai day, the Emperor issued an edict for a court examination of xiucai scholars in the hall of audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the yihai day of the first month of spring, the emperor issued an edict for a court examination of xiucai scholars in the hall of audience.

sentences.zh: 以太子少傅魏收為兼尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince Wei Shou was appointed Concurrent Right Deputy Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince Wei Shou was made Concurrent Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 己卯，兼右僕射魏收以阿縱除名。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, Concurrent Right Deputy Director Wei Shou was dismissed from office for fawning and indulgence.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Concurrent Right Vice Director Wei Shou was dismissed from office for fawning and indulgence.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以武明皇后配祭北郊。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, Empress Wuming was given paired sacrifice at the Northern Suburban Altar.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Empress Wuming was given paired sacrifice at the Northern Suburban Altar.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，帝臨都亭錄見囚，降在京罪人各有差。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, the Emperor went to the Capital Pavilion to review prisoners brought before him, and reduced the sentences of criminals in the capital, each according to his case.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, the emperor went to the Capital Pavilion to review prisoners and reduced the sentences of criminals in the capital, each according to the circumstances of his case.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，詔司空斛律光督五營軍士築戍於軹關。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the yichou day, an edict ordered Minister of Works Hulu Guang to supervise soldiers of the Five Garrisons in building a fortress at Zhiguan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the yichou day, an edict ordered Minister of Works Hulu Guang to supervise soldiers of the Five Garrisons in building a fortress at Zhiguan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，室韋國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, the state of Shiwei sent envoys to pay court tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, the Shiwei sent envoys to pay court tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以兼尚書右僕射趙彥深為左僕射。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, Concurrent Right Deputy Director Zhao Yanshen was appointed Left Deputy Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Concurrent Right Vice Director Zhao Yanshen was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，幷、汾、晉、東雍、南汾五州蟲旱傷稼，遣使賑恤。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, the five provinces of Bing, Fen, Jin, East Yong, and South Fen suffered crop damage from insects and drought; envoys were dispatched to provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, insects and drought damaged crops in the five provinces of Bing, Fen, Jin, East Yong, and South Fen; envoys were dispatched to provide relief.

sentences.zh: 戊午，陳人來聘。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, envoys from Chen came on a mission of friendly inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, envoys from Chen came on a diplomatic visit.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，詔以城南雙堂閏位之苑，廻造大總持寺。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the renwu day, an edict ordered that the park south of the city at the intercalary position of the Twin Halls be converted to build the Great Zongchi Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the renwu day, an edict ordered the park south of the city at the intercalary-position Twin Halls to be converted into the Great Zongchi Monastery.

sentences.zh: 秋八月辛丑，詔以三臺宮為大興聖寺。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on the xinchou day, an edict ordered that Santai Palace be converted into Daxingsheng Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the xinchou day, an edict ordered Santai Palace to be converted into Daxingsheng Monastery.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月癸巳，陳人來聘。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on the guisi day, envoys from Chen came on a mission of friendly inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on the guisi day, envoys from Chen came on a diplomatic visit.

sentences.zh: 己酉，周將楊忠帥突厥阿史那木汗等二十餘萬人自恒州分為三道，殺掠吏人。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, Zhou general Yang Zhong led more than two hundred thousand men including the Turk Ashina Muhan from Heng Province in three columns, killing and plundering officials and commoners.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, the Northern Zhou general Yang Zhong led more than two hundred thousand men, including the Turk Ashina Muhan, from Heng Province in three columns, killing and plundering officials and commoners.

sentences.zh: 是時，大雨雪連月，南北千餘裡平地數尺，霜晝下，雨血於太原。

translations.literal: At this time, heavy rain and snow continued for months; for over a thousand li north and south the flat ground was covered to a depth of several feet; frost fell in daytime; and blood rained at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: At this time heavy rain and snow continued for months. For more than a thousand li north and south the flat ground lay under several feet of snow; frost fell in daytime; and blood rained at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊午，帝至晉陽。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, the Emperor reached Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, the emperor reached Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 己未，周軍逼幷州，又遣大將軍達奚武帥眾數萬至東雍及晉州，與突厥相應。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day, the Zhou army pressed Bing Province; they also sent Great General Daxi Wu leading tens of thousands of troops to East Yong and Jin Province, coordinating with the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, the Northern Zhou army pressed Bing Province. They also sent Great General Daxi Wu with tens of thousands of troops to East Yong and Jin Province, coordinating with the Turks.

sentences.zh: 是歲，室韋、庫莫奚、靺羯、契丹並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, the Shiwei, Kumo Xi, Mojie, and Khitan all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Shiwei, Kumo Xi, Mojie, and Khitan all sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚申朔，周軍至城下而陳，戰於城西。

translations.literal: In spring of the third year, on the gengshen day, the new moon, the Northern Zhou army reached below the city walls and deployed in battle order; they fought west of the city.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the third year, on the gengshen day—the first of the month—the Northern Zhou army reached the walls, drew up in battle order, and fought west of the city.

sentences.zh: 周軍及突厥大敗，人畜死者相枕，數百里不絕。

translations.literal: The Northern Zhou army and the Turks were utterly defeated; dead men and livestock lay piled one upon another for hundreds of li without end.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Zhou army and the Turks were routed; the dead, both men and livestock, lay heaped together for hundreds of li without a break.

sentences.zh: 詔平原王段韶追出塞而還。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Prince Duan Shao of Pingyuan to pursue them beyond the frontier and then return.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Prince Duan Shao of Pingyuan to pursue the enemy beyond the border and then withdraw.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，以律令班下，大赦。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the xinyou day, statutes and ordinances were promulgated, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinyou day, the new statutes and ordinances were issued and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，盜殺太師、彭城王浟。

translations.literal: On the jisi day, robbers killed Grand Preceptor Prince You of Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, assassins murdered Grand Preceptor Prince You of Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以司空斛律光為司徒，以侍中、武興王普為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, Minister of Works Hulu Guang was made Minister over the Masses, and Palace Attendant Prince Pu of Wuxing was made left vice-director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Minister of Works Hulu Guang was appointed Minister over the Masses, and Palace Attendant Prince Pu of Wuxing was appointed left vice-director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以尚書令、馮翊王潤為司空。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, Director of the Masters of Writing Prince Run of Fenyang was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, Director of the Masters of Writing Prince Run of Fenyang was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，詔兼散騎常侍皇甫亮使於陳。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinmao day, an edict appointed Acting Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Huangfu Liang envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinmao day, an edict appointed Acting Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Huangfu Liang envoy to Chen.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，帝至自晉陽。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the jiazi day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiazi day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以尚書令、趙郡王叡為錄尚書事，以前司徒婁叡為太尉。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, Director of the Masters of Writing Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery was made recorder of the affairs of the Masters of Writing, and the former Minister over the Masses Lou Rui was made grand commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Director of the Masters of Writing Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery was appointed recorder of the affairs of the Masters of Writing, and the former Minister over the Masses Lou Rui was appointed grand commandant.

sentences.zh: 甲申，乙太傅段韶為太師。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, Grand Tutor Duan Shao was appointed Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, Grand Tutor Duan Shao was appointed Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以太尉、任城王湝為大將軍。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, Grand Commandant Prince Cheng of Rencheng was made grand general.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Grand Commandant Prince Cheng of Rencheng was appointed grand general.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，行幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, the emperor went on an imperial progress to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, the emperor set out on an imperial progress to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，大雨晝夜不息，至甲辰乃止。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the gengzi day, heavy rain fell day and night without cease until the jiachen day, when it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the gengzi day, torrential rain fell day and night without letup until the jiachen day, when it finally stopped.

sentences.zh: 是月，晉陽訛言有鬼兵，百姓競擊銅鐵以捍之。

translations.literal: That month, a rumor spread in Jinyang that ghost soldiers were abroad, and the common people vied to strike copper and iron to repel them.
translations.idiomatic: That month a rumor spread in Jinyang of ghost soldiers on the march, and the people vied to beat copper and iron to drive them off.

sentences.zh: 殺樂陵王百年。

translations.literal: Prince Bainian of Leling was put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Bainian of Leling was executed.

sentences.zh: 歸宇文媼于周。

translations.literal: Lady Yuwen was sent back to Northern Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Yuwen was returned to Northern Zhou.

sentences.zh: 秋九月乙丑，封皇子綽為南陽王，儼為東平王。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn, on the yichou day, the emperor's sons Chuo and Yan were enfeoffed as Prince of Nanyang and Prince of Dongping, respectively.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn, on the yichou day, the princes Chuo and Yan were enfeoffed as Prince of Nanyang and Prince of Dongping, respectively.

sentences.zh: 是月，歸閻媼于周。

translations.literal: That month, Lady Yan was sent back to Northern Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Lady Yan was returned to Northern Zhou.

sentences.zh: 陳人來聘。

translations.literal: Envoys came from Chen on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys from Chen arrived on a diplomatic visit.

sentences.zh: 突厥寇幽州，入長城，虜掠而還。

translations.literal: The Turks raided You Province, entered the Great Wall, plundered, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks raided You Province, crossed the Great Wall, carried off plunder, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙未，詔遣十二使巡行水潦州，免其租調。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the yiwei day, an edict dispatched twelve envoys to tour flood-stricken provinces and exempt them from land tax and corvée levies.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the yiwei day, an edict dispatched twelve envoys to inspect flood-ravaged provinces and exempt them from land tax and corvée levies.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，突厥寇幽州。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, the Turks raided You Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, the Turks raided You Province.

sentences.zh: 周軍三道並出，使其將尉遲迥寇洛陽，楊檦入軹關，權景宣趣懸瓠。

translations.literal: Northern Zhou armies advanced in three columns, sending their generals Yuchi Jiong to raid Luoyang, Yang Biao to enter Zhiguan Pass, and Quan Jingxuan to press toward Xuanhu.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Zhou armies marched out in three columns, sending the generals Yuchi Jiong against Luoyang, Yang Biao through Zhiguan Pass, and Quan Jingxuan toward Xuanhu.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲午，迥等圍洛陽。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on the jiawu day, Jiong and the others besieged Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the jiawu day, Yuchi Jiong and his fellows besieged Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔兼散騎常侍劉逖使於陳。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, an edict appointed Acting Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Liu Ti envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, an edict appointed Acting Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Liu Ti envoy to Chen.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，太尉婁叡大破周軍於軹關，擒楊檦。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, Grand Commandant Lou Rui routed the Northern Zhou army at Zhiguan Pass and captured Yang Biao.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Grand Commandant Lou Rui routed the Northern Zhou army at Zhiguan Pass and took Yang Biao prisoner.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、靺羯、新羅並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Goguryeo, Mojie, and Silla all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Goguryeo, Mojie, and Silla all sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 山東大水，饑死者不可勝計，詔發賑給，事竟不行。

translations.literal: Great floods struck the region east of the mountains; those who died of famine were beyond counting. An edict ordered relief grain distributed, but in the end it was never carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Catastrophic flooding struck the region east of the mountains, and famine deaths were beyond counting. An edict ordered relief grain to be distributed, but in the end nothing was done.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月癸卯，以大將軍、任城王湝為大司馬。

translations.literal: In spring of the fourth year, on the guimao day of the first month, Grand General Prince Cheng of Rencheng was made grand marshal.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fourth year, on the guimao day of the first month, Grand General Prince Cheng of Rencheng was appointed grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 辛未，幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, the emperor went on an imperial progress to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the emperor went on an imperial progress to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，詔以新羅國王金真興為使持節、東夷校尉、樂浪郡公、新羅王。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the jiayin day, an edict appointed Jin Zhenxing, king of Silla, bearer of the imperial staff, colonel of the Eastern Yi, Duke of Lelang commandery, and King of Silla.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiayin day, an edict appointed Jin Zhenxing, king of Silla, bearer of the imperial staff, colonel of the Eastern Yi, Duke of Lelang commandery, and King of Silla.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以年穀不登，禁酤酒。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, because the year's grain did not ripen, the sale of wine was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, because the harvest had failed, the sale of wine was banned.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔減百官食稟各有差。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, an edict reduced the grain rations of officials at every rank, each according to a fixed scale.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, an edict reduced officials' grain rations at every rank, each by a fixed amount.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，詔給西兗、梁、滄、趙州，司州之東郡、陽平、清河、武都，冀州之長樂、渤海遭水潦之處貧下戶粟，各有差。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the wuzi day, an edict granted grain to poor households in flood-stricken parts of the provinces of Western Yan, Liang, Cang, and Zhao; the eastern commanderies of Dong, Yangping, Qinghe, and Wudu in Sizhou; and Changle and Bohai in Jizhou, each according to a fixed scale.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the wuzi day, an edict granted grain to poor households in flood-stricken districts of Western Yan, Liang, Cang, and Zhao provinces; the eastern commanderies of Dong, Yangping, Qinghe, and Wudu in Sizhou; and Changle and Bohai in Jizhou, each according to a fixed scale.

sentences.zh: 家別鬥升而已，又多不付。

translations.literal: Per household it amounted to only a few pecks and sheng, and even that was often not paid out.
translations.idiomatic: Each household received only a few pecks and sheng at most, and even that was often never delivered.

sentences.zh: 是月，彗星見；

translations.literal: That month, a comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: That month a comet appeared.

sentences.zh: 有物隕於殿庭，如赤漆鼓帶小鈴；

translations.literal: An object fell in the palace courtyard like a red-lacquered drum fitted with small bells.
translations.idiomatic: Something fell in the palace courtyard, shaped like a red-lacquered drum hung with small bells.

sentences.zh: 殿上石自起，兩兩相對。

translations.literal: Stones in the hall rose on their own, facing one another in pairs.
translations.idiomatic: Stones in the hall rose by themselves, pairing off face to face.

sentences.zh: 又有神見於後園萬壽堂前山穴中，其體壯大，不辯其面，兩齒絕白，長出於唇，帝直宿嬪御已下七百人咸見焉。

translations.literal: Again a spirit appeared in a mountain cave before the Wanshou Hall in the rear garden; its body was huge, its face indistinguishable, and its two teeth were stark white and projected beyond the lips. The emperor and all seven hundred palace women on night duty, down to the lowest ranks, saw it.
translations.idiomatic: A spirit also appeared in a mountain cave before the Wanshou Hall in the rear garden. Its body was enormous, its face impossible to make out, and its two teeth were bone-white and thrust out beyond the lips. The emperor and all seven hundred palace women on night duty, down to the lowest ranks, beheld it.

sentences.zh: 帝又夢之。

translations.literal: The emperor also dreamed of it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor dreamed of it as well.

sentences.zh: 天統四年十二月辛未，太上皇帝崩於鄴宮乾壽堂，時年三十二，諡曰武成皇帝，廟號世祖。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the fourth year of Tiansong, on the xinwei day, the retired emperor died in the Qianshou Hall of the Ye Palace. He was thirty-two years old. His posthumous title was Emperor Wucheng, and his temple name was Shizu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the fourth year of the Tiansong era, on the xinwei day, the retired emperor died in the Qianshou Hall of the Ye Palace. He was thirty-two years old. He was posthumously titled Emperor Wucheng, with the temple name Shizu.

sentences.zh: 五年二月甲申，葬於永平陵。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifth year, on the jiashen day, he was buried at Yongping Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fifth year, on the jiashen day, he was buried at Yongping Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 全文以中華書局、一九七二年十一月、第一版《北齊書》為本校。

translations.literal: The full text has been collated against the first edition of the Book of Northern Qi published by Zhonghua Shuju in November 1972.
translations.idiomatic: The full text of this chapter has been collated against the first edition of the Book of Northern Qi (Zhonghua Shuju, November 1972).
